subject: Plot with bars and line : how to add the line legend ?

messages.author: 638e58e9e87d1a85
messages.subject: Plot with bars and line : how to add the line legend ?
parts:
Dear list,

I use the following code to draw the attached plot.

resultPlot <- ggplot()
resultPlot <- resultPlot + geom_bar(data=df, mapping=aes(x=month, y=value, fill=gear_type, order=gear_type), stat="identity", width=0.8) + scale_fill_brewer(palette="Set1", name="Gear type")
resultPlot <- resultPlot + geom_errorbar(data=dfPrev5Years, mapping=aes(x=month, ymax = mean_prev_5_years + stddev_prev_5_years, ymin=mean_prev_5_years - stddev_prev_5_years), width=0.25, color="dimgray")
resultPlot <- resultPlot + geom_line(data=dfPrev5Years, mapping=aes(x=month, y=mean_prev_5_years))
resultPlot <- resultPlot + xlab("Month") + ylab("Catches in tons") + ggtitle(paste(levels(df$species)[1], "monthly catches by gear type on", levels(df$year)[1]))

print(resultPlot)

And I just want to add a legend for the line and for the error bars. How can I do ?

regards,
Norbert

library(ggplot2)
sampleNb <- 60

resultPlot <- resultPlot + geom_line(data=fakeSecondDf, mapping=aes(x=month, y=mean_previous, group="month"))

print(resultPlot)

messages.author: 373beb702917b8b5
messages.subject: Re: Plot with bars and line : how to add the line legend ?
parts:
Hi,

AFAIK there is no easy way to get a legend for the different types of
geoms. Legends display aesthetic mappings, and the type of geom is not
considered an aesthetic. If you can tolerate having the "legend"
inside the plot area you can fake it with annotate(), otherwise you
will need to use annotation_custom() and learn enough about the grid
package to figure out how to use it.

Here is a crude example of the first approach:

library(ggplot2)

tmp <- data.frame(x = 1:20, y=(1:20)^2)

ggplot(tmp, aes(x=x, y=y)) +
geom_point() +
geom_line() +
annotate(geom="line", x=c(19:20), y=c(0:0)) +
annotate(geom="point", x=19, y=10) +
annotate(geom="text", x=18, y=2, label="my line label", hjust=1) +
annotate(geom="text", x=18, y=10, label="my point label", hjust=1)

HTH,
Ista
